title: Bakugatari Zzz
description:
Bakumura Utaka runs a dormitory for high school girls. Her true identity is that of a Baku, a legendary creature that eats dreams! In order to indulge in her favorite dreams of youthful girls in their springtime of life, Utaka creates an environment to improve the quality of the dorm residents' sleep, but she just can't seem to catch any dreams... 
It turns out that humans don't dream if they're in a deep sleep. In other words, her perfectly prepared sleeping environment has the opposite effect! Upon learning this shocking truth, Utaka devises a plan to help the residents achieve REM sleep but... 

A dizzying girls' dream story drawn by the talented Burio Michiru begins!
author: Burio Michiru
